title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 029
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute classify and columns variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Four round dots arranged in a two by two grid
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple four item classification grid made from dots.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for square or petal grids when the four round dots are the visible cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the most minimal classify variant as four evenly spaced dots.

items.depicts_observation: Four tile grid with three square panels and one top right diamond panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a classification grid made from square tiles with one diamond tile.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for dot or petal grids when the square and diamond tile mix matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses three square tiles plus one diamond instead of circles or petals.

items.depicts_observation: Four petal tiles arranged around the center like a clover grid
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a softer rounded classification grid built from petal like tiles.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for dot or square tile grids when the petal shapes are the key cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot rounds each tile into a petal form instead of circles or square blocks.

items.depicts_observation: Rectangle frame split into two tall vertical column panels
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a framed two column layout instead of a classify grid.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for free standing bars when the outer rectangle frame should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows two vertical columns enclosed by one outer rectangle frame.

items.depicts_observation: Two separate tall column bars standing apart with no outer frame
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants two free standing column bars instead of a framed split rectangle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the framed column icon when the outer container should be absent.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot removes the outer frame and leaves only two separate vertical bars.
